name: Kimi to Issho ni 2
source:
The main character, who belonged to the track and field club, quit the club due to his injured leg.
One day, he suddenly got acquainted with his senior Nagasawa Sayuri, and joined the "love research department" that she created.

At first, it was an awkward atmosphere because he was the only boy in the club, but him and the heroines gradually became aware of the feeling of love...
translation:
主角原本是田径部的成员，但因腿部受伤而退出了田径部。
某天，他突然结识了前辈长泽小百合，并加入了她创建的“爱情研究部”。

起初，因为他是俱乐部里唯一的男孩，气氛很尴尬，但他和女主角们逐渐意识到了爱的感觉……
